states.name: boil water kettle
states.definition: Filling the kettle with water and turning it on to boil.

states.name: grind coffee beans
states.definition: Opening the coffee bag, scooping beans into the electric grinder, and grinding them into powder.

states.name: assemble coffee filter
states.definition: Placing the V60 filter on top of the coffee jug and pouring the ground coffee into the filter.

states.name: brew drip coffee
states.definition: Pouring hot water from the kettle into the V60 filter over the coffee grounds and letting it drain.

states.name: wash coffee cups
states.definition: Washing coffee cups and utensils in the sink using running water and a sponge.
